sources.snippet: 🧠 Overview The Emotion Classifier is a lightweight web app built using Streamlit and Hugging Face Transformers. It uses a fine-tuned DistilBERT model to detect the underlying emotion expressed in text. The model predicts one of six emotions: sadness, joy, love, anger, fear, or surprise.
